d: Ash-brown hair is styled with blunt bangs and two long, thick braids resting over the shoulders. The eyes are a warm amber-brown with a soft, neutral expression. The face is that of a young teenager with a slender build. The outfit consists of a short black dress with a pleated skirt and a matching black hooded cloak featuring a deep crimson lining, accented by a crimson bow at the neck and silver trim on the sleeves. The character holds a bolt-action rifle with a brown wooden stock and a metallic grey barrel.
